lines.text: That old tap could be hiding valuable metal.
Many old taps, door handles and fittings are brass, an alloy of copper and zinc.
A magnet helps: brass won't stick, but brass-plated steel will.
Clean brass is graded separately from brass with steel parts attached, so sort them apart.
Then compare quotes from a few local buyers, because prices change.
